steps.content: **WHEN** the Operator completes the top-up and takes payment

change_note: Added FBD-100268 (Product Configuration matrix — 'Recharge Allowed' = Yes for HHD), which is what actually establishes HHD does top-ups; FBD-100261 alone never mentions HHD (it's written around POS issue flows). 'Period' in the product data-variations list has no match in the card-format taxonomy (FBD-100250) or anywhere else searched — marked GAP in place rather than dropped silently.

title: Top-Up — a Multi-Journey top-up exceeding the configured maximum is prevented
preconds:
**GIVEN** an Operator topping up a Multi-Journey smartcard already close to the configured maximum journey count
**AND** the tester knows the currently configured maximum and an example top-up that would exceed it
change_note: The literal '45-journey maximum' is not in FBD-100261 or anywhere else in the requirement library — reworded per the assumed-knowledge-value pattern (config number, not a fixed spec fact) rather than hard-coding an unverified figure. The underlying behaviour (a maximum exists and is enforced) itself has no citation either — flagged to gap register for confirmation the enforcement behaviour exists at all, not just the number.

flagged-gap: 'expired journeys are removed before a new top-up is applied' has no supporting text anywhere in FBD-100261 or any other spec searched. This is a behaviour-existence gap (not just a value), logged to the gap register — case body left as-is pending engineer confirmation.

Added FBD-100236 — the DESFire ABT card's Operator Number field (`0x2057`, Flowbird's Translink identifier) is the concrete mechanism that makes a non-Translink card rejectable; FBD-100261 doesn't cover card-format rejection at all.

Dropped FBD-100373 — that spec explicitly scopes refunds to POS only ('HHD = sales+reversals, no refunds', REQ-1630.0) and citing it here risks a tester applying the POS URN-based Refund workflow to HHD, which the same spec says doesn't exist. The in-flow 'annul a failed-print top-up and hand back the cash' behaviour is plausible (analogous to ETM's annul-on-failed-print pattern) but has no HHD-specific citation — flagged to gap register rather than left under a contradicting ref.

Dropped FBD-100341 — that spec's title and scope are explicitly 'Revenue Apportionment & Reporting (TVM & POS)'; a full-text search found zero mentions of HHD anywhere in the document. Wrong device surface; FBD-100261 already covers the MERIT reporting-granularity claim being made.
flagged-gap: see batch changelog/gaps file — FBD-100716 describes only the automated cEMV-inspection back-office Standard Fare, not a manual operator-issued printed 'penalty warning' ticket.
flagged-gap: neither cited spec describes a penalty warning issued off a smartcard (non-cEMV) inspection result; both only cover the cEMV bank-card Standard Fare path.
flagged-gap: no operator-menu 'issue a penalty fare' action, nor a printed penalty fare ticket, appears anywhere in FBD-100716.
flagged-gap: same core issue — manual issuance against an invalid/expired smartcard (not a cEMV bank card) is not in either cited spec.
flagged-gap: role-differentiated ticket printing (Operator vs Supervisor) has no textual support in FBD-100716.
flagged-gap: an operator 'whitelist' for issuing penalty fares is not mentioned anywhere in FBD-100716 (searched for 'whitelist' directly — zero hits).

Dropped FBD-100341 (wrong device scope, see 4103892). flagged-gap: 'client shift id' is genuinely required on the cEMV inspection event codes (5008-5013) per FBD-100716 para 353, but that's the automated inspection audit, not an operator-triggered 'penalty fare' transaction — the manual-issuance framing itself is unconfirmed.
flagged-gap: a waybill listing issued penalty warnings/fares is not mentioned in FBD-100716; waybills appear elsewhere (ETM/POS flow docs) but never in a penalty context.

flagged-gap: FBD-100383 is the Operator Hierarchy (location/config tree) spec — a full-text search for sign-on, PIN, or duty terms returns zero hits. No HHD-specific sign-on design doc exists in the local library; closest analog is the POS Overflow flow (knowledge/flows/translink-pos-signon.md), which is not cited and is unconfirmed for HHD.
flagged-gap: same citation problem as 4103901 — FBD-100383 has no sign-on content. The POS flow doc shows an analogous 'Sign On Failed... N of 3' screen but isn't confirmed for HHD.

flagged-gap: FBD-100383 has zero lockout/'Device Locked' content. POS Overflow flow shows a 3-attempt lockout + 'Device Locked — Present Supervisor Card' screen, but nothing confirms this is identical on HHD.
flagged-gap: FBD-100383 has no duty-number content at all.
flagged-gap: FBD-100383 has zero Message-of-the-Day / Word-and-Colour content. The POS Overflow flow shows this exact pattern (both with 'Unavailable' fallbacks) but for POS, not HHD.
flagged-gap: FBD-100383 has no sign-off content.
flagged-gap: FBD-100383 has no inactivity/auto-sign-off content.
flagged-gap: FBD-100383 has no docking/forced-sign-off content; the POS flow doc's 'power interruption' behaviour is a different scenario (power loss, not docking).

Dropped 'CR78' — not a locatable document/entry in the requirement library (--find returns nothing). Neither FBD-100651 nor FBD-100690 contain any 'driver break'/'operator break'/resume-mode text (checked directly) — the mode-preservation-across-breaks claim is unsupported by either cited spec.
flagged-gap: FBD-100342 (User Claims) covers only the KeyCloak back-office admin menus (Users/Groups/Role Mappings) — zero content on the HHD's on-device Operator Menu.
flagged-gap: FBD-100276 is a back-office-only REST API for pay-in machines ('No user interaction' per its own scope) — it does not describe an on-device 'View Totals' menu option at all.

custom_expected:
The operator prints a mini-statement receipt summarising the duty's totals.

**GAP** — specific layout reference ("NIR Layout 20 / Glider Format 15") not found in any spec searched; confirm before running.

[Automatable: Partial]
change_note: Dropped FBD-100276 (back-office API, no on-device mini-statement content). The specific layout numbers quoted in Expected Result have no source anywhere in the library — marked GAP rather than asserted as fact.

flagged-gap: FBD-100260 (Product Name Usage) is about display-description resolution rules and has zero mentions of a 'favourites' feature. No spec anywhere in the library describes a sale-favourites function — the existence of this capability itself is unconfirmed, not just its citation.
Same issue as 4103913: 'CR78' unfindable, and neither cited FBD contains break/resume-mode content.
flagged-gap: FBD-100266 (Device Heartbeat) is entirely about the back-office Comms Monitor/staff-list heartbeat; it never describes an on-device 'Status' menu option.

Same core gap as the Penalty Warning & Fares section (4103893-4103900): neither FBD-100716 nor FBD-100690 describes an operator-menu 'issue a penalty fare warning' action or a printed penalty warning ticket — both only describe the automated cEMV Standard Fare and its display as a 'Penalty Fare' icon in Journey History.

Dropped FBD-100383 (zero printer/pairing content, confirmed by search). FBD-100320 confirms the HHD Bluetooth-pairs to its Miura M020 *payment* device, which is the closest documented analog, but does not confirm ticket-printer pairing specifically — flagged to gap register.
